text:
Dear Larkspur team,

I am writing to inquire about hiring the Wexcombe Regent for my daughter's wedding. We require the vehicle on Sat 13 Mar 2027, from 14:30 until 7:00 pm, and we plan to collect it from your garage. It would also be ideal if the vehicle could be provided with a chauffeur. I have attached a copy of my driving licence.

Kind regards,
Imogen Quillfeather
